text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Twinkle Series over, Seiun Sky has managed to get some terrific results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we've successfully navigated the crucial first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And as for Seiun Sky herself…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nnn… Can't… run anymore…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Sky!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're supposed to train with me today! Wake up this instant!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: SKY!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: S-Sei! Come on, wake up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I can't… hear you… Done for the day…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear. Evidently, she's faking it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That's a scary face you're makin', Grass!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky's trainer! Don't just stand there staring into space! Do something!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess I can't let Seiun Sky weasel her way out of training like this…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sweeten the deal.
choice_data_list: No limits on bait and extra tackle rentals!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Geeez, you always know just how to reel me in, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: How did that wake her up?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just what are you two playing at? Are you always bargaining with one another like this?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Bargaining?! Nooo, we're just playing around is all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph, now it's clear. These are simply jests between a peerless trickster and her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha! Peerless? You're giving me too much credit there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trying to reel each other in back and forth can get boring if it's the same ol' story.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And I'm always just looking to have fun. Right, Trainer? ♪
